Analyze the React app at /tmp/ruflo/v3/goal_ui (Vite + React + TypeScript) for unnecessary re-render and render-path performance issues. EXCLUDE node_modules, dist, tests.

Key files to read fully:
- /tmp/ruflo/v3/goal_ui/src/pages/Index.tsx (~1655 lines)
- /tmp/ruflo/v3/goal_ui/src/pages/Agents.tsx (~1347 lines)
- /tmp/ruflo/v3/goal_ui/src/App.tsx
- /tmp/ruflo/v3/goal_ui/src/main.tsx
- /tmp/ruflo/v3/goal_ui/src/widget.tsx
- All files under /tmp/ruflo/v3/goal_ui/src/components/ (especially AgentStep.tsx, DevelopmentStep.tsx, ReviseResearchForm.tsx, ResearchReportModal.tsx, StateAssessmentCard.tsx, ResearchReviewCard.tsx, GoalInput.tsx, GOAPConfigDisplay.tsx, WidgetCustomizer.tsx)
- All files under /tmp/ruflo/v3/goal_ui/src/components/agents/ (DependencyGraph.tsx, ExecutionDashboard.tsx, QualityGates.tsx, RealTimeEventLog.tsx, StepExecutionPanel.tsx)
- /tmp/ruflo/v3/goal_ui/src/lib/goapPlanner.ts
- Any state/store/context files (zustand, context) - search for them

Run these ripgrep searches:
- rg -n 'useEffect|useMemo|useCallback|useContext|useState|React.memo|memo\(' src/ (excluding node_modules)
- rg -n 'style=\{\{' src/
- rg -n 'value=\{\{' src/
- rg -n 'key=\{(i|index|idx)\}' src/
- rg -n '=>\s*\(.*\)\s*=>' src/  (inline handlers)
- rg -n '\.filter\(|\.map\(|\.sort\(|\.reduce\(' src/ (derived data)
- rg -n 'new Date\(\)|structuredClone|JSON.parse' src/
- rg -n 'createContext|useContext' src/
- rg -n 'zustand|create\(' src/

For each finding return: file path, line number(s), a 6-12 line excerpt (verified against actual file content - do NOT guess), what component re-renders unnecessarily and why, the user-visible symptom, and a concrete fix with a small before/after code example (useMemo/useCallback/React.memo/split context/move state down).

Find 6-12 findings. Prioritize the two big pages (Index.tsx, Agents.tsx) and any list/grid rendering. Verify all excerpts against actual files.

Specifically look for:
1. Inline object/array/function literals passed as props or used as dependencies defeating referential equality
2. useEffect with object/array/function deps that change every render (missing useMemo/useCallback)
3. Missing memoization on expensive derived values (.filter/.map/.sort) rebuilt every render
4. Components taking large object props that re-render on unrelated parent state changes (React.memo candidates)
5. Context value objects created inline in a provider with value={{ a, b }}
6. useState for derived data that could be useMemo
7. Lists without stable key (index keys when items reorder)
8. Inline new Date()/structuredClone/heavy JSON parse in render body
9. Zustand/context selectors subscribing to whole store instead of a slice
